status_definitions.ready: One unique compatible Input is deterministically resolved and both runs pass current eligibility rules.
status_definitions.review_required: The available evidence is ambiguous, inconsistent, documented as problematic, or not yet supported automatically.
status_definitions.blocked_no_control: No compatible Input control is available under the current deterministic pairing rules.
status_definitions.excluded: The IP run is explicitly excluded by the experimental eligibility review.
